test_cases.summary:
Verify Empty state message clarity
when no records exist
test_cases.description:
Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Empty state message clarity
Given no records exist
When the empty state appears
Then the message should be simple and non-technical
test_cases.acceptance:
The message should be simple and non-technical
The behavior should be validated when the empty state appears.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Show failed fetch toast on API error
when the server request fails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Show failed fetch toast on API error
Given the server request fails
When the fetch attempt completes
Then a "Failed to fetch" toast notification should appear
test_cases.acceptance:
A "Failed to fetch" toast notification should appear
The behavior should be validated when the fetch attempt completes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Application remains stable on fetch failure
when a network/server error occurs
test_cases.description:
Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Application remains stable on fetch failure
Given a network/server error occurs
When the UI handles the error
Then the application should not crash or freeze
test_cases.acceptance:
The application should not crash or freeze
The behavior should be validated when the UI handles the error.

test_cases.summary:

when a backend failure occurs
test_cases.description:
Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Hide technical error details
Given a backend failure occurs
When the error message is shown
Then no stack trace or technical details should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
No stack trace or technical details should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the error message is shown.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Retry after failure
when fetch failed previously
test_cases.description:
Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Retry after failure
Given fetch failed previously
When the user refreshes or retries
Then the system should attempt to reload data successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should attempt to reload data successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes or retries.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Immediate empty state rendering
when data length is zero
test_cases.description:
Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Immediate empty state rendering
Given data length is zero
When rendering occurs

test_cases.acceptance:
Empty state should display without delay
The behavior should be validated when rendering occurs.

test_cases.summary:

Feature: Error & Empty State Handling
Scenario: Empty message readable and visible
